markdown.instructions:
- Environment: dev. Use a dev API key with `Authorization: Bearer $AISA_API_KEY`.
- API base: `https://dev-api.aisa.one/apis/v1`. Follow each operation's servers.
- Dev OpenAPI: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AIsa-team/docs/refs/heads/dev/openapi.yaml.
- Call only operations present in the dev contract. Do not make paid calls to test availability.
- Never print, log, or commit API keys.
